title: [GMCP 203.014.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Official Tasks extension and durable long-running work
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-014-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: The official Tasks extension is implemented on both client and server for get, update, cancel, notifications, state transitions, expiry, retries, ownership and server-directed execution. Durable tasks survive process restart exactly once, compose with MRTR and progress, enforce terminal-state invariants, and reject stale, cross-user, forged or replayed task handles. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
